independence_statement: Independently inspected stored raw trajectories, embedded contracts and source documents, outcome labels, preflight metadata and evaluator source. Did not inspect reviewer A or other newly generated review files. No human review is implied.
classification_policy: Classify the failure against the natural-language task contract and observed state. Preserve frozen evaluator labels; proposed reviewer labels do not retroactively rewrite pilot metrics. Ambiguous marks a case with overlapping plausible failure causes, not automatic uncertainty about every paraphrase.

limitations: Seven semantic false-negative findings are review judgments over this small synthetic tuning set, not a validated general semantic grader.
One abstention failure also has an evaluator wording mismatch; both causes are retained.
Preflight metadata supports operational classification but not reconstruction of every interrupted tool event.
